messages:
olivia_cs: Hey team — high priority from Acme Corp. They reported we debited a customer instead of applying a customer payment. Customer-facing log shows the autorouter invoked adjust_invoice_line instead of apply_payment. Customer is paused until we confirm. :grimacing:

samir_eng: Yikes. Can you paste the raw tool invocation payload from the logs?

olivia_cs: Copied from prod log:```json
{"tool": "adjust_invoice_line", "args": {"invoice_id": "inv_9A2", "amount": 5000, "currency": "USD", "note": "auto-apply"}}
```

kevin_oncall: And the expected call?

olivia_cs: Should have been:```json
{"tool": "apply_payment", "args": {"payment_id": "pay_44B", "invoice_id": "inv_9A2"}}
```

erica_ml: Interesting — both signatures share invoice_id and optional amount fields in some variants. The autorouter uses signature overlap + first-match heuristic.

samir_eng: Do we have the full NLU/heuristic trace in the request? Any intent_hint or discriminator field present?

olivia_cs: Customer message (sanitized): "We received a payment — please post it to invoice inv_9A2 (payment pay_44B)." No explicit intent_hint. The agent UI sent payload with payment_id but the ML extractor sometimes places payment_id in metadata vs args; in this case payment_id ended up in metadata.payment instead of args.payment_id. That made apply_payment appear less compatible.

ops-bot: [alert] autorouter selected tool adjust_invoice_line (confidence 0.62) over apply_payment (confidence 0.58) due to missing required arg match.

kevin_oncall: Root cause: ambiguous signatures + missing required arg in args. This is a reproducible pattern.

samir_eng: Repro steps I used locally: 1) Send chat payload with invoice_id + metadata.payment. 2) No intent_hint. 3) Autorouter picks adjust_invoice_line. Verified with unit test.

erica_ml: Short-term mitigation: update router priority so apply_payment has higher precedence for payloads containing both invoice_id and any payment identifier in metadata. Also add a strict field-match penalty for moving an identifier into metadata.

samir_eng: I can ship a hotfix to increase weight for apply_payment and require payment_id to be considered if it appears in metadata.payment. Pushing to staging now.

olivia_cs: Can we also add a quick UI warning to agents when the router confidence delta < 0.1? That would have flagged this before sending to prod.

samir_eng: Yep. I'll add a confidence delta banner and a short-term guard to block adjust_invoice_line when payment_id exists either in args or metadata unless explicitly confirmed.

kevin_oncall: Customer notified and we reversed the adjust by issuing credit hold. Need post-mortem note and a rollback plan if hotfix causes false negatives.

erica_ml: Follow-up: ML team will add a small training corpus of payment-labeled examples and tweak feature extraction for metadata vs args. Long-term: canonicalize identifiers in the input step so router sees them consistently.

olivia_cs: Thanks — please add timeline and PR links here. Customer wants ETA for fix and confirmation we won't double-charge. :thumbsup:

samir_eng: Hotfix PR: https://git.redwood/infra/autorouter/pulls/2782 (staging green). Rolling to prod in 30m with blackout window and manual confirmation checks.

kevin_oncall: I'll monitor. If anything odd, page the oncall channel. :eyes:

olivia_cs: Appreciate it. Will update Acme once prod patch is verified.
